sections.title: Overview
sections.text:
| Method | Path | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| [GET](#get-ocsp) | `/v1/ocsp` | Get OCSP configuration |
| [PUT](#put-ocsp) | `/v1/ocsp` | Update OCSP configuration |

sections.title: Get OCSP configuration
sections.text:
GET /v1/ocsp

Gets the cluster's OCSP configuration.

#### Required permissions

| Permission name |
|-----------------|
| [view_ocsp_config](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/references/rest-api/permissions#view_ocsp_config) |

sections.title: Request
sections.text:
#### Example HTTP request

	GET /v1/ocsp 


#### Request headers

| Key | Value | Description |
|-----|-------|-------------|
| Host | cnm.cluster.fqdn | Domain name |
| Accept | application/json | Accepted media type |

sections.title: Response
sections.text:
Returns an [OCSP configuration object](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/references/rest-api/objects/ocsp).

#### Example JSON body

[code example]

sections.title: Error codes
sections.text:
When errors occur, the server returns a JSON object with `error_code` and `message` fields that provide additional information. The following are possible `error_code` values:

| Code | Description |
|------|-------------|
| ocsp_unsupported_by_capability | Not all nodes support OCSP capability |

sections.title: Status codes
sections.text:
| Code | Description |
|------|-------------|
| [200 OK](http://www.w3.org/Protocols/rfc2616/rfc2616-sec10.html#sec10.2.1) | Success |
| [406 Not Acceptable](http://www.w3.org/Protocols/rfc2616/rfc2616-sec10.html#sec10.4.7) | Feature not supported in all nodes |

sections.title: Update OCSP configuration
sections.text:
PUT /v1/ocsp

Updates the cluster's OCSP configuration.

#### Required permissions

| Permission name |
|-----------------|
| [config_ocsp](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/references/rest-api/permissions#config_ocsp) |

sections.title: Request
sections.text:
#### Example HTTP request

	PUT /v1/ocsp 

#### Example JSON body

[code example]

#### Request headers

| Key | Value | Description |
|-----|-------|-------------|
| Host | cnm.cluster.fqdn | Domain name |
| Accept | application/json | Accepted media type |

#### Request body

Include an [OCSP configuration object](https://redis.io/docs/latest/operate/rs/references/rest-api/objects/ocsp) with updated fields in the request body.

sections.title: Error codes
sections.text:
When errors occur, the server returns a JSON object with `error_code` and `message` fields that provide additional information. The following are possible `error_code` values:

| Code | Description |
|------|-------------|
| invalid_schema | An illegal parameter or a parameter with an illegal value |
| no_responder_url | Tried to enable OCSP with no responder URL configured |
| ocsp_unsupported_by_capability | Not all nodes support OCSP capability |

sections.title: Status codes
sections.text:
| Code | Description |
|------|-------------|
| [200 OK](http://www.w3.org/Protocols/rfc2616/rfc2616-sec10.html#sec10.2.1) | Success, OCSP config has been set |
| [400 Bad Request](http://www.w3.org/Protocols/rfc2616/rfc2616-sec10.html#sec10.4.1) | Bad or missing configuration parameters |
| [406 Not Acceptable](http://www.w3.org/Protocols/rfc2616/rfc2616-sec10.html#sec10.4.7) | Feature not supported in all nodes |
